import Aesop

theorem square_translation_modulus (a k n : ℤ)  : (a + n * k) ^ 2 ≡ a ^ 2 [ZMOD n] := by
  have h1 : a + n * k ≡ a [ZMOD n] := by
    have h2 : a + n * k - a = n * k := by ring
    have h3 : n ∣ n * k := by
      use k
      <;> ring
    
    rw [Int.ModEq]
    have h4 : (a + n * k - a) % n = 0 := by
      have h5 : (n * k) % n = 0 := by
        simp [Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]
      rw [h2] at *
      exact h5
    
    simp [h4, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] at h3 ⊢
    <;> omega
  
  have h2 : (a + n * k) ^ 2 ≡ a ^ 2 [ZMOD n] := by
    
    have h3 : (a + n * k) ^ 2 ≡ a ^ 2 [ZMOD n] := by
      
      calc
        (a + n * k) ^ 2 ≡ a ^ 2 [ZMOD n] := by
          
          exact Int.ModEq.pow 2 h1
        _ = a ^ 2 := by rfl
    exact h3
  
  exact h2
